issues: Fused Dempster conflict K_w is frame-size dominated (median ~0.996 for 13-couple casts vs 0.045 for 3-couple finals); it is exported as a diagnostic only, with certainty driven by the panel discount q_w and the frailty posterior instead.

Catalog coverage of realized eliminations is not assessable at the nominal 90% level (an eliminated couple's phi must be the weekly minimum a priori); coverage is reported via the Dirichlet-marginal overlap test (100%) and the P(elim) reliability curve (AUC 0.959, Brier 0.047) instead.
Partner leave-one-out strength carries a small temporal leak (all-time partner history); a strict leave-one-SEASON-out hazard refit bounds the effect at +0.008 pp AUC.
Diana Nyad (S18) has elim_week 2 but scores only in week 1; she is handled by the censored-at-last-scored-week convention (single documented exception).
